newsitem.title: USA: Maine plane crash leaves two dead, two missing.
newsitem.headline: Maine plane crash leaves two dead, two missing.

text.p: Coast Guard crews searched Penobscot Bay Thursday for wreckage of a small plane that crashed, killing two people and leaving two missing.
The Piper Cherokee had taken off from Pittsfield and sounded as if it was having engine problems just before it crashed into the ocean Wednesday evening, witnesses told police.
The bodies of pilot Doug Reed, of Waterville, and Henry Sharman, of Sinking Springs, Pennsylvania, were recovered shortly after the accident.
Reed's wife Beryl and Sharman's wife Edna were missing and presumed dead, the Coast Guard said.
